terminology.false_runtime_refusal: a live runtime refusal of a SPEC-legal workflow (to be measured in final-original test runs; none measured yet).

terminology.scope_correction: an invariant narrowed/rewritten because SPEC on re-read does not support the declared audience (recorded, not silently deleted).
terminology.timeout: command exceeding its 180s bound (recorded with exit=124).
terminology.unproved_unsupported: invariant status unproved (needs separate reduction named in reasons; e.g. raw rule probes, capture/live-parent, cross-table disclosure, system/job paths).
